TITLE: Israel can expect 'tens or hundreds of missiles a day' if Iran war renews, expert warns
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-19 10:32 (updated 10:48)
AUTHOR: Maya Zanger-Nadis
SOURCE: Jerusalem Post

KEY (Hamidreza Azizi, Iranian security expert at German Institute for International and Security Affairs, to NYT):
- "Iran may fire tens or hundreds of missiles per day" in renewed war
- Purpose: "effectively confront the enemy and also change the calculation on the other side"
- In Feb 2026, Iran was prepared for long-lasting war and rationed missiles for several weeks
- Now: Iranian leaders aim for "short but high intensity" war
- Need to defend energy infrastructure from coordinated heavy strikes
- May target GULF OIL FIELDS, REFINERIES, AND PORTS to damage global economy and pressure US
- Would put Gulf nations in difficult position — forced to participate in war they wanted to avoid

BAB AL-MANDAB STRAIT:
- Iran may leverage Bab al-Mandab Strait (Red Sea-Indian Ocean) same way as Hormuz
- Would force US to focus on "two maritime fronts instead of one"
- Houthis (Iranian proxy) carried out previous attacks from Yemen
- Yemen expert Inbal Nissim-Louvton: fears of Houthis disrupting strait have led Gulf nations to "absorb Iranian attacks without responding in kind"

TRUMP TRUTH SOCIAL POST (Monday) — fuller quotes:
- "There seems to be a very good chance that they can work something out. If we can do that without bombing the hell out of them, I would be very happy"
- "It's a very positive development, but we'll see whether it amounts to anything"
- "Based on my respect for the above-mentioned leaders, I have instructed Secretary of War, Pete Hegseth, the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, General Daniel Caine, and the United States Military that we will NOT be doing the scheduled attack of Iran tomorrow"
- "Serious negotiations are now taking place, and that, in their opinion, as Great Leaders and Allies, a Deal will be made"
- "This Deal will include, importantly, NO NUCLEAR WEAPONS FOR IRAN!"
- "Further instructed them to be prepared to go forward with a full, large-scale assault of Iran, on a moment's notice, in the event that an acceptable Deal is not reached"
